entities.name: Bani Bakur
entities.description: A human woman of Ardestan on Shandalar who believed in the champion Kenan Sahrmal and later commanded Ardestan.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: City on Shandalar, home of Bani Bakur.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane on which Bani Bakur lived.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: A champion of Shandalar in whom Bani believed; his apprentices include Azor.

entities.name: Ravash Mog
entities.description: Bani's duel-sister, who fell into a pit through Lim-Dûl's magic.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who called himself Magus and led undead hordes against Ardestan.

entities.name: War for Shandalar
entities.description: The war during which Bani fought undead in the Shadowwood.

entities.name: Shadowwood
entities.description: A place where Bani and Ravash fought off undead.

entities.name: Catacombs
entities.description: Place where Bani and Ravash looked for Kenan Sahrmal and found Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A figure Lim-Dûl blamed for the world's suffering; he left Shandalar with Leshrac.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Left Shandalar together with Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Anthanor
entities.description: A soldier who attacked Szat alongside Bani.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: War twelve years later in which Lim-Dûl's undead assaulted Ardestan.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: One of Kenan Sahrmal's apprentices, who stole a spell to imprison Lim-Dûl and was trapped with him in his own body.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: A barrier around Shandalar that depends on the confinement of Lim-Dûl.

events.summary: Bani and Ravash Mog fight off undead in the Shadowwood, then find Lim-Dûl in the Catacombs, who calls himself Magus; Ravash falls into a pit.
events.quote: but Ravash fell into a pit due to Lim-Dûl's magic

events.summary: Bani and soldiers attack Tevesh Szat; the real Kenan Sahrmal appears, and Szat and Leshrac leave Shandalar.
events.quote: The real Kenan Sahrmal appeared, and Tevesh Szat and Leshrac left Shandalar.

events.summary: Realizing she had been used, Bani beheads Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: Bani, realizing she had been used, beheaded Lim-Dûl.

events.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl's undead hordes assault Ardestan, which Bani commands.
events.quote: she was a commander of Ardestan, and fought against Lim-Dûl's hordes of undead who assaulted the city

events.summary: Azor's spell and Lim-Dûl's counter trap both spirits within Azar's body; Sahrmal secretly buries the body to keep the Great Barrier standing.
events.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

relations.quote: Bani and her duel-sister, Ravash Mog

relations.note: Beheaded him, though he survived by spirit-leaping into Sahrmal's body.
relations.quote: Bani, realizing she had been used, beheaded Lim-Dûl.
one of Kenan Sahrmal 's apprentices, Azor
she was a commander of Ardestan
